The player avatar ('Glitchen') is a 2D side-view cartoon character with customizable gender-neutral proportions, facial features, hair, clothing layers, masks, and rideable costume mounts.
Avatar movement consists of horizontal walking left/right and a low-gravity, floaty jump arc that allows landing on elevated terrain ledges, tree branches, and multi-tiered house roofs.

Avatars have distinct animations for idle breathing/blinking, walking, jumping, mining with a pickaxe, watering/tending plants, drinking/tasting, hugging, high-fiving, squeezing chickens, and synchronized dancing.
Temporary buffs/consumables can shrink avatars to miniature size or enlarge ('embiggen') them to giant size while retaining full movement.

Clicking any interactive world object, NPC, other player, or inventory item opens a context-sensitive popup menu of verbs (e.g., 'Talk to', 'Mine', 'Pet', 'Squeeze', 'Drink', 'Taste', 'Give', 'Drop', 'Bestow', 'Play').
Pressing number keys triggers social emotes (such as key '5' to wave 'hi', or 'bye' during the final shutdown hour), and pressing 'Tab' cycles between active chat channels.

The game world ('Ur') is divided into regions (e.g., Zhambu, Kalavana, Andra, Groddle, Uralia), each composed of interconnected 2D side-scrolling streets linked by signposts at street boundaries and doors to interior rooms.
Walking into a signpost path or clicking a building door triggers a loading screen ('Entering [Street] in [Region]', 'recalculating splines...') that transitions the player into the destination area.

Every player has a persistent, publicly visitable 'Home Street' featuring an exterior house, resource nodes, project slots, and a Magic Rock that allows changing the street's visual and musical theme (e.g., 'Lost Woods', 'Vam Road') for 190
